title: 第8章：建材仓库，LV2升级
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

那辆皮卡车并没有走。

而是在后面悄悄跟随，

林昊也没有回头，一脚把油门踩到了底。

现在车子速度80码，车身也因为超重和路面的不平整，颠簸的像要散架一样。

车厢里面，周建国抓着座位的后座，

此时王德发的箱子从他怀里滑了出去，撞到了一旁的陈明的腿上。

但陈明一声也没吭。

一直跑了十几公里的路，林昊从后视镜里面看了几眼，

后面的路上空空的。

那俩皮卡车没有追上来。

不知道是把它甩掉了，还是抄了近路去了别的地方。

但现在暂时是安全了，

他把车速将到了60码，沿着省道又继续开了半个多小时，天色也渐渐暗了下来。

此时路边的路牌被车灯照得清清楚楚，

“龙安工业园东区”！

终于到了~

房车开下了省道，进入了一片被铁丝网围起来的地方，门口的保安亭的窗户玻璃碎了一地。

里面是十几栋大小差不多的厂房和仓库，厂区的路灯全是坏的，里面一片漆黑。

林昊把车停在了厂房的偏僻处，熄火拔了钥匙。

“铁柱，建国，你们俩和我下去。”

苏晴，你在车顶上放风，有情况就按喇叭。

陈明，你守好车门！

我？......

周建国楞了一下，指了指自己，他刚刚从鬼门关爬出来，腿现在都还是软的。

“你不是电工吗？厂里的设备是你保养的！”

说罢，林昊从储物柜里面抽出一根半米长的钢管，丢给了他。

你拿着钢管，跟在铁柱后面，他让你干什么，你就干什么就行。

周建国手里拿着钢管，看了一眼赵铁柱，又看了一眼林昊，咬了咬牙。

“好的！”

系统面板铺了开来，整个工业园的俯瞰图全部加载了出来。

【工业区扫描完成】

【监测到移动目标：普通丧尸15，分散分布】

【3号仓库：物资信号强烈】

【7号仓库：检测到未知蓝色信号标记】

15只普通丧尸，还好是分散分布的，这比高速上那几十只一窝蜂的丧尸好对付多了。

赵铁柱走在最前面，防爆叉斜提着，走路没有发出一点点声音。

周键国跟在他后面三米远，手里紧紧的握着钢管。

林昊走在后面殿后，手里握着手枪，保险也已经

此时，前方的废弃轮胎后面晃出来一只丧尸，赵铁柱快步走了上去。

侧身躲过，手里的叉子往丧尸耳后根猛的一捅，直接把丧尸的头穿了一个大窟窿。

丧尸像泄了气的皮球，哐的一声，栽倒在地上，抽搐了两下，一动不动了。

周建国眼皮跳了几下，他看着倒地的丧尸，吞了口唾沫，手里的钢管握得更紧了。

生怕丧尸装死，又爬起来咬他......

紧接着，第二只、第三只丧尸前面的装卸平台后面冲了出来，速度不慢......

林昊抬起了手......砰！，一声枪响！

子弹精准的打在了前面左边的那只丧尸的前额上，瞬间丧尸的后脑勺就破了一个大洞。

林昊自己都顿了一下，这几天摸枪以来，熟练度越来越好，起手三点一线，2秒钟就开火了。

居然可以一枪爆头，以前玩电脑射击游戏炼出来的技术，现在可以派上用场了。

真特么带劲！

赵铁柱冲了上去，面对右边的那只丧尸，叉子往丧尸额头上猛的一戳，当时就戳穿了丧尸的头颅。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The pickup truck wasn't leaving.

But quietly following behind,

Lin Hao didn't look back and stepped on the accelerator to the bottom.

The current speed of the car is 80 yards, and the body of the car is bumpy and seems to be falling apart due to the overweight and uneven road surface.

Inside the carriage, Zhou Jianguo grabbed the back seat of the seat.

At this time, Wang Defa's box slipped out of his arms and hit Chen Ming's leg beside him.

But Chen Ming didn't say a word.

After running for more than ten kilometers, Lin Hao took a few glances in the rearview mirror.

The road behind was empty.

The two pickup trucks did not catch up.

I don’t know if I got rid of it or took a shortcut and went somewhere else.

But it's safe now,

He reduced the speed of the car to 60 yards and continued driving along the provincial highway for more than half an hour, and the sky gradually darkened.

At this time, the road sign on the roadside was clearly illuminated by the car lights.

"Long'an Industrial Park East Area"!

Finally arrived~

The RV drove off the provincial road and entered an area surrounded by barbed wire. The window glass of the security booth at the door was shattered.

Inside are a dozen factories and warehouses of similar sizes. The street lights in the factory area are all broken, and it is pitch dark inside.

Lin Hao parked the car in a remote area of ​​the factory, turned off the engine and took out the key.

"Tiezhu, Jianguo, you two come down with me."

Su Qing, please let the wind blow on the roof of the car, and honk the horn if necessary.

Chen Ming, guard the car door!

I?...

Zhou Jianguo was stunned for a moment and pointed at himself. He had just climbed out of the hell gate, and his legs were still weak.

"Aren't you an electrician? You maintain the equipment in the factory!"

After that, Lin Hao pulled out a half-meter-long steel pipe from the locker and threw it to him.

You hold the steel pipe and follow the iron pillar. Just do whatever he asks you to do.

Zhou Jianguo held the steel pipe in his hand, glanced at Zhao Tiezhu, then at Lin Hao, and gritted his teeth.

"Okay!"

The system panel was laid out, and the aerial view of the entire industrial park was loaded.

[Industrial area scan completed]

[Moving targets detected: 15 ordinary zombies, scattered]

[Warehouse No. 3: Strong signal of supplies]

[Warehouse No. 7: Unknown blue signal mark detected]

The 15 ordinary zombies were fortunately scattered, which was much easier to deal with than the dozens of zombies swarming on the highway.

Zhao Tiezhu walked in the front, holding his anti-explosion fork diagonally and making no sound as he walked.

Zhou Jianguo followed him three meters away, holding the steel pipe tightly in his hand.

Lin Hao was walking behind, holding a pistol in his hand, and the safety was on.

At this time, a zombie emerged from behind the abandoned tire ahead, and Zhao Tiezhu walked up quickly.

He dodged sideways and stabbed the zombie behind the ear with the fork in his hand, directly punching a big hole in the zombie's head.

The zombie fell to the ground like a deflated ball, twitched twice, and became motionless.

Zhou Jianguo's eyelids twitched a few times. He looked at the zombies lying on the ground, swallowed, and held the steel pipe in his hand tighter.

He was afraid that the zombie would pretend to be dead and get up to bite him again...

Immediately afterwards, the second and third zombies rushed out from behind the loading and unloading platform in front of them, and they were not slow...

Lin Hao raised his hand... Bang!, a gunshot!

The bullet accurately hit the forehead of the zombie on the left in front, and instantly there was a big hole in the back of the zombie's head.

Lin Hao himself paused. Over the past few days, his proficiency with the gun has gotten better and better. He started with three points and one line and fired in two seconds.

He can actually shoot a headshot with one shot. The skills he developed by playing computer shooting games can now be put to use.

So exciting!

Zhao Tiezhu rushed forward, faced the zombie on the right, and stabbed the zombie's forehead with his fork, piercing the zombie's head at that time.
